description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Transmission Main Shaft Bushes for the Samurai 5 Speed Transmission.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Bushes, Main Shaft
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
